item.description:
NVBeacon is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring remote NVIDIA GPU servers over SSH with `nvidia-smi`, process exit alerts, and GPU idle notifications.
- Hardened SSH command execution by draining standard output and standard error while commands run, preventing full output pipes from blocking polling. - Improved cancellation and timeout cleanup so local SSH commands are terminated and reaped, including commands that ignore normal termination. Cancelled collection does not start a retry. - Limited captured command output to 8 MiB per command to keep unusually large responses from growing memory without a bound. - Prevented duplicate process metadata from causing a crash; the latest matching reading is retained. - Extracted platform-independent models, parsers, collection logic, and the existing server backup format into NVBeaconCore, while keeping macOS SSH execution and credential handling in the app. - Added process lifecycle regression tests, shared-core tests, and macOS/Linux CI checks.
